_readme: Curated per-episode content for the individual episode pages at /episodes/<slug>, and for the tags/subjects shown on the podcast list page. Match episodes to the RSS feed by 'episodeNumber' (itunes:episode). Any episode NOT listed here still gets a page automatically — either AI-generated (see functions/_lib/ai-summary.js) or, with no API key configured, built from the RSS feed alone. 'pageTitle' overrides the on-page H1 and <title> with SEO-friendly phrasing. 'pillars' is an array of one or two values from the show's own fixed 5-value framework (what KIND of value the episode provides): Peer Story, Nuanced Literacy, Future Planning, What Not to Do, Core Skills. 'subjects' is an array of short, specific business-topic tags (e.g. 'Real Estate', 'Cold Outreach') — freeform, no fixed list.
